backgroundBoundary: All scoped and closed-source-refined queries remain in each original window, including PKCE and polling/background work. queryDiagnostics.boundary: Projected artifact contains all four measured-window query rows; outside-window query rows are not exported. Global capture range/reason counters are reported values, not independently reconstructed outside-window rows.
interpretation: Unknown context and unknown SQL structure are independent dimensions; every query remains in the SQL budget.

Only original SQL ordinals define windows. Invocation completion timestamps only validate receipt pairing, not SQL membership.
Closed-source refinement includes background polling endpoints; it does not prove asynchronous execution. No scope label or unknown row is subtracted.
Normalized structure equality proves neither equal parameters nor redundant work. Groups are diagnostics, not permission to remove reads.
